result.summary: The main visual defect is overlapping restaurant metadata in the first "Popular right now" card, making the delivery/time details unreadable. Other clipped cards appear consistent with horizontally scrollable carousels.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the "25–35 min" text overlaps the adjacent delivery/category metadata, producing garbled text beneath the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Use a responsive metadata row with adequate spacing or separate lines; prevent text elements from occupying the same horizontal area and truncate/wrap content when necessary.

issues.description: The restaurant carousel cards at the right edge are visibly cut off, which may look unfinished if horizontal scrolling is not obvious to users.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel behavior is discoverable, for example by preserving a clear partial next-card preview with consistent spacing or adding a subtle scroll affordance.
